summary.text: Victoria Spartz is the Republican incumbent for Indiana's 5th District. Born in Ukraine, she immigrated to the United States in 2000, worked as an accountant and finance executive and started several businesses, served in the Indiana Senate from 2017 to 2020, and was elected to Congress in 2020.

paragraphs.text: Spartz was born in Nosivka, Ukraine, in 1978, and immigrated to the United States in 2000 after meeting her husband, Jason. She became a U.S. citizen, according to her official biography.

She earned a bachelor's degree in international economics and an MBA from the National University of Economics in Ukraine, and a Master of Professional Accountancy (listed by Ballotpedia as an M.P.A.) from Indiana University's Kelley School of Business in 2006. She also completed a Harvard Business School executive education program on health care.

Spartz worked as a certified public accountant and auditor, including at Big 4 public accounting firms for Fortune 500 companies, and taught as an adjunct faculty member at Indiana University's Kelley School of Business.
According to her official biography, she served as chief financial officer at the Indiana Attorney General's Office and started several businesses in financial consulting, farming and real estate.
Spartz served in the Indiana Senate (District 20) from 2017 to 2020. She was elected to the U.S. House in 2020, took office in 2021 succeeding Rep. Susan Brooks, and was re-elected in 2022 and 2024.

In the 119th Congress she serves on the Joint Economic Committee and, according to her official biography, leads working groups on healthcare and budget reforms. She previously served on the House Judiciary Committee.
She lives in Noblesville with her husband, Jason, and their two daughters, according to her official biography.
